about: One word-time rule for the Mac (mnema-asr: FluidAudio with TDT_EMISSION_DELAY_FRAMES=0, then Mnema's words) and the server (ONNX greedy TDT). tokens are greedy TDT emissions in order: piece, encoder frame (0.08 s), predicted duration in frames. start/end are the token's time in seconds as FluidAudio gives it (null: <unk> is dropped before timing): a token ends after its duration; one of zero duration ends at the next token's start, at least a frame later. words: a word starts at a piece with ▁ (FluidAudio gives a leading space instead) and spans its pieces; service tokens <…> are never words or parts of one.
